product: OpenAI Codex Cloud (provider-hosted cloud tasks from published cloud environments); automation entry `codex cloud` CLI (Experimental) plus `codex apply` (Stable)
cli_version: 0.162.0 (source tag rust-v0.162.0, released 2026-10-08T18:55:59Z; main HEAD 22ebb0fb178f at check time); docs pages state no version
auth_mode_common: ChatGPT account sign-in via `codex login` (OAuth or device code). API-key auth is rejected for cloud (`auth.uses_codex_backend()` check). Requests carry ChatGPT bearer token and ChatGPT-Account-Id header.
backend_note: CLI calls private routes under https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/* (tasks, tasks/list, tasks/{id}, tasks/{id}/turns/{turn}/sibling_turns, environments, environments/by-repo/...). Not a documented public API; direct use is non-qualifying.
non_qualifying_surfaces: local codex / codex exec / codex resume
OpenAI Agents API POST /v1/agents/sessions, Responses API, Agents SDK (distinct product)
ChatGPT web/desktop/mobile UI and Slack/Teams delegation
desktop app internal task tools, browser automation, scraped cookies

launch.invocation: codex cloud exec --env ENV_ID [--attempts 1-4] [QUERY] (documented); --branch BRANCH and stdin query source-only. Request body {new_task:{environment_id,branch,run_environment_in_qa_mode:false},input_items:[message],metadata:{best_of_n}?}; source-only CODEX_STARTING_DIFF adds pre_apply_patch item. Stdout: task URL only.
launch.idempotency: none; no client request/idempotency key; retry after ambiguous failure may duplicate; readback only by scanning list
launch.failure_retention: exits non-zero on submission failure; unstructured error text; command labeled Experimental

inspect_status.invocation: codex cloud list [--env ENV_ID] [--limit 1-20] [--cursor C] --json -> {tasks:[{id,url,title,status,updated_at,environment_id,environment_label,summary,is_review,attempt_total}],cursor?} (documented); codex cloud status TASK_ID (source-only, plain text, exit 1 unless ready)
inspect_status.failure_retention: lossy status enum pending|ready|applied|error; backend cancelled and failed both map to error, in_progress maps to pending; task record retention undocumented

observe_replay.invocation: none; polling list/status only. Assistant messages fetched only by interactive TUI from private GET /wham/tasks/{id}; no event stream, log, tool-call or setup-log retrieval
observe_replay.failure_retention: no cursor/offset; no replay after disconnect

follow_up.invocation: UI only (web/mobile/desktop 'request follow-ups'; Slack/Teams same-account follow-up). No CLI subcommand or backend client method
follow_up.failure_retention: existing task keeps its saved files; saved VM state recoverable up to 7 days after last turn or resume

cancel_interrupt.invocation: none; AttemptStatus::Cancelled exists only as a read-only status value
cancel_interrupt.failure_retention: cancelled surfaces as error in list/status

usage.invocation: none per task; account-level rate-limit/profile routes exist only privately in backend client, not exposed by codex cloud

output_artifact_custody.invocation: codex apply TASK_ID (documented, Stable; git apply, non-zero on conflict); codex cloud diff TASK_ID [--attempt N] and codex cloud apply TASK_ID [--attempt N] source-only; PR/commit/branch push UI-only
output_artifact_custody.idempotency: diff fetch read-only; apply local with preflight
output_artifact_custody.failure_retention: unified diff is the only retrievable artifact; no PR URL, branch or commit SHA returned

environment_selection.invocation: --env ENV_ID on exec/list (documented; unique label also accepted in source); listing only via interactive `codex cloud` picker; create/edit/publish/republish/share UI-only
environment_selection.failure_retention: no environment revision/publish id/setup digest exposed; republish affects new tasks only

configuration_materialization.invocation: environment-level UI config only: repositories, install script, start skill, env vars, network secrets, internet allowlist, VPN, OIDC; repo AGENTS.md and repo skills read from checkout; personal skills not synced; local MCP may be unavailable in cloud; only admin-managed MCP hooks on cloud orchestrator (Work Cloud wording), command/local/plugin hooks unsupported; no per-task overrides on exec
configuration_materialization.auth_mode: n/a for configuration (UI); ChatGPT sign-in for launch
configuration_materialization.failure_retention: only per-task injection is branch and source-only CODEX_STARTING_DIFF patch; applicability of Work Cloud hook rule to Codex Cloud tasks is ambiguous

approval_suspension_resume.invocation: none programmatic; UI permission control (Do anything / Approve for me) and UI/Slack prompts only; exec has no approval-policy flag
approval_suspension_resume.failure_retention: a paused hosted task cannot be answered or resumed by automation

subordinate_lineage.invocation: none for subagents; best-of-N only: attempt_total in list JSON (documented), sibling_turn_ids and sibling_turns route TUI/source only

bounded_continuation_compaction.invocation: none hosted; thread/compact/start is local app-server only; continuation only via UI follow-up or new task
bounded_continuation_compaction.failure_retention: saved VM state up to 7 days after last turn/resume; context-window behavior undocumented

missing_operations: public stable task API or non-experimental CLI contract with documented JSON schema, usable with a server-side credential
idempotent task create (client request/idempotency key or lookup by client reference)
structured launch result with task_id, environment revision, resolved branch and commit
follow-up: send a new turn to an existing hosted task, returning a turn id
cancel/interrupt the active turn with a distinct terminal cancelled state
resumable event stream or paged log (turn/item/tool/command output) with documented retention
fine-grained per-turn status including setting_up, awaiting_input, cancelled
list and answer pending approval/input requests programmatically; per-task approval-policy selector
artifact custody: PR URL, branch, commit SHA retrieval and programmatic PR/branch push
non-interactive environment listing with revision/publish id or setup digest
per-task configuration overrides (model, instructions/AGENTS.md, MCP, hooks, network) or attestation of loaded config
context usage read, compaction trigger or explicit rollover
